notes.title: Automatic SMS Bank Discovery
notes.detail: Instantly scans and detects active bank accounts from SMS alerts upon permission grant, eliminating manual bank account setup.

notes.title: Interactive Account Review & Control
notes.detail: Review detected bank accounts, edit 4-digit account numbers, update current balances, and remove unwanted accounts before linking.

notes.title: Smart Historical Catch-up Sync
notes.detail: Seamlessly imports the past 30 days of transactions strictly for confirmed accounts with intelligent category classification and accurate local timestamps.

notes.title: Zero-Knowledge Privacy Architecture
notes.detail: 100% on-device SMS parsing where message text never leaves the phone. Strict hardware-backed envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM + AWS KMS) at rest in the database.
